name: EPIC 212161295
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 5, 11.7 solar radii and 1.01 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 212161295 (K2 campaign 5): PARAM radius (solar radii) 11.658649 (16th-84th percentiles 11.222968-12.223331), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

text.card: A red giant 1,812 parsecs away, 12 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 5, give 1.01 solar masses and 11.7 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,352 K at its surface.
